name: Pocket Pikachu
description: A nostalgic Pocket Pikachu with headset steps, original-style settings, a daily alarm and native controller play.
author: josethevrtech
license: MIT (integration); third-party assets retain their rights
about: Walk, work out, and grow your friendship with Pikachu. Earn watts for gifts and slots. Grip to pick up; shake to return to the shelf. Either stick or the left D-pad plays, with A/B/X/Y for confirm/back/friendship/settings. Hold the holding-stick click while moving it to adjust distance. Set the clock, alarm and sound inside the handheld.
